The alert identifies files F1 and F2 in the transfer; UC4 classifies F1 as HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL with CREDENTIALS_SECRETS and F2 as CONFIDENTIAL source code. The subject is a Software Engineer with expected data classes SOURCE_CODE and INTERNAL, and the timeline shows a large bulk download earlier the same day before the upload. Verified external-transfer policy evidence was insufficient, so this remains a potential data-exposure incident requiring analyst investigation."
